abstract: This month’s issue of the Motion Images Journal represents a different tack for SMPTE. Instead of focusing on a broad topic such as workflows, imaging technologies, or audio, we have decided to turn the spotlight on 8K video–more specifically, the acquisition and distribution of what the Society officially classifies as ultrahigh definition (UHD)-2, or video with at least 7,680 horizontal and 4,320 vertical pixels in each frame.

authors.bio: Peter H. Putman is the president of ROAM Consulting LLC, which provides training, marketing, and product testing/development services to manufacturers, dealers, and end-users of displays, display interfaces, and related connectivity products. He is a contributing editor for Sound and Communications Magazine, the leading trade publication for commercial audiovisual systems integrators. He holds the BA degree in communications from Seton Hall University, South Orange, NJ, and the MS degree in television and film from Syracuse University, Syracuse, NY. He is an Info-Comm Senior Academy Instructor for the International Communications Industries Association (ICIA), and he was named ICIA’s Educator of the Year for 2008. He is a member of both SMPTE and the Society for Information Display (SID). In addition, he holds industry certifications from ICIA (Certified Technology Specialist) and the Imaging Science Foundation.
